messages:
rupert: heads-up — found a strange parity/ordering bug affecting Rust + Java SDKs in the embeddings+rerkank sample app. batching helper pads to batch boundary but after an auth-refresh+retry one returned vector is short and rerank scores don't line up.

rupert: minimal repro (Rust): use devex-batcher v0.7.0, batch 3 items -> pads to 4, simulate token expiry between enqueue and send. occasionally last embedding length = 1023 vs expected 1024.

anika: thanks for filing. quick Q: are you using the helper that flattens into a single request buffer or the SDK's internal per-item batcher?

rupert: helper from sample-app (it tags pads with __pad=true and relies on server to drop padded rows). the problematic trace shows a 401, token refresh, then "replaying batch" logs.

rupert: request logs: \n```
[batcher] id=701 size=4 pads=1 pad_index=3
[auth] 401 -> refresh -> retry
[batcher] replay id=701
```

rupert: response snippet (sanitized):
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1024 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1024...]},{"embedding":[...1024...]},{"embedding":[...1023 floats...]}],"model":"embed-1024"}
```

dave: this sounds familiar — earlier we saw a similar issue where mutable batch metadata was updated after enqueue. some languages snapshot pad metadata, others mutate. that yields mismatches during replay.

mika: another angle: if auth-retry reconstructs the outgoing request but the helper's pad markers were stored as references to a mutable buffer, they may flip when other code touches the buffer. immutable snapshot on enqueue should fix.

anika: short-term mitigations: (1) SDKs should validate embedding length against model profile on response assembly and raise EmbeddingShapeError if mismatch; (2) batch helper should deep-clone pad metadata when creating retry records; (3) add telemetry when shape mismatch detected so we can measure.

rupert: agreed. also rerank depends on positional mapping: score arrays are indexed to embeddings by position. if ordering changes or pads get misapplied, rerank returns wrong results silently which is worse than a hard error.

dave: for a robust fix we should ask runtime to include top-level "embedding_dim" and per-item "source_index" in /v1/embeddings response. that makes remapping deterministic even if server filters pads differently. cc @eng-runtime.

mika: I've filed DE-5207: "Rust/Java batcher pad snapshot lost on auth-retry -> short embedding + rerank misalignment" with logs and a small repro harness. devex-bot linked the issue.

devex-bot: created issue DE-5207 and attached PR template.

anika: i'll push a tiny change to the Rust helper to snapshot pad flags at enqueue and add this check during assembly:
```
if embedding.len() != expected_dim {\n  emit telemetry("embed.shape_mismatch", {"expected": expected_dim, "got": embedding.len(), "req": req_id});\n  return Err(EmbeddingShapeError{ expected_dim, got: embedding.len(), req_id });\n}
```

rupert: nice. Java helper patch should mirror behavior (snapshot + fail-fast). we'll publish canary helpers v0.7.1 and v0.7.1-java.

dave: tests: add CI scenario expire-token-mid-batch for Rust/Java/Python x batch sizes 2..8 x pad positions. validate zero occurrences of shape_mismatch telemetry after fix.

mika: server action item: include embedding_dim and request_id in JSON body so SDKs can validate without inferring. also include per-item source_index to help rerank mapping. opened ENG-RUNTIME ticket and cc'd runtime owners.

anika: rolling validation-only canary first (non-breaking). if telemetry shows zero regressions, follow-up runtime change to include embedding_dim can be rolled later.

rupert: thanks all. I'll attach the minimal repro harness to DE-5207 and run local canary once patches land. will update thread. :thumbsup:

mika: patch PRs ready, adding unit tests + integration scenario. posting canary link in DE-5207 once CI passes.

devex-bot: linked PRs and test results to DE-5207.

anika: closing loop when canary green and runtime update scheduled. great catch, rupert.
